invariants.statement: Every internal Pages link resolves under the /impactful-tom base path.
Navigation, headings, landmarks, focus visibility, color contrast, and image alternatives remain usable without relying on color or pointer-only interaction.
README and Pages describe observed repository and release state while keeping clean-install, causal invocation, restart, and Claude behavior unclaimed.
Visual assets preserve the approved founder-constraint mark and introduce no likeness, quotation, affiliation claim, or third-party mark.
The v1.0.0 tag and release assets remain unchanged; the correction is confined to post-release main-branch documentation and evidence.
Public pages expose canonical URL, Open Graph title, description, image, and Twitter card metadata with absolute HTTPS URLs.

risks.statement: Pages is enabled without a real landing page -> visitors reach an incomplete or generic build -> the public documentation route fails at discovery.
Relative paths ignore the project base URL -> navigation or assets resolve at the account root -> customers encounter broken links and missing images.
Custom visual presentation lacks semantic and contrast discipline -> keyboard, low-vision, or screen-reader users lose the task path -> documentation readiness is overstated.
Main-branch documentation retains prepublication wording -> public visitors are told the repository and release do not exist -> trust and install decisions are corrupted.
Generated visual derivatives drift from the approved mark or include identity-coded material -> the product acquires a competing or misleading brand surface -> rights and product coherence regress.
Post-release documentation repair silently changes release-bearing plugin or tagged artifacts -> v1.0.0 custody no longer matches its published receipts -> release evidence becomes false.
Social metadata points to a missing, oversized, or incorrectly proportioned card -> shared links render poorly or without product identity -> discovery quality remains unfinished.
